input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: Argument.get_help_record returns (metavar, self.help) unchanged, so an argument with help=None yields a None description instead of the empty string the new docstring promises.
- rationale: Trigger: a command with one documented argument and one undocumented argument. format_help_text only calls write_dl when any argument has help, then passes the undocumented argument's record (metavar, None) to write_dl. The formatter then processes None as text, which either raises a TypeError or renders incorrectly. Impact: the help page for such a command crashes or is malformed, where the title says it should show an empty description.
critique: The finding identifies the same faulty operation: get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so an undocumented argument produces None. It also traces the same path, where a command mixes documented and undocumented arguments and the None record reaches write_dl, causing a TypeError crash. The function name given (format_help_text rather than format_arguments) is a minor difference, and the mechanism is the same.
